units.source_text: 堪舆家（看风水者）以十二支代表方向。

en.t: Geomancers, that is, those who read feng shui, use the twelve earthly branches to represent directions.

units.source_text: 其法：画一圆圈，从圆心放射十二条直线，使与圆周相交。

en.t: The method is to draw a circle, then draw twelve straight lines radiating from the center so that they meet the circumference.

units.source_text: 从上方一交点起，向右顺次注明子丑寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥十二支。

en.t: Starting from the upper intersection point, mark the twelve branches in order to the right: zi, chou, yin, mao, chen, si, wu, wei, shen, you, xu, and hai.

units.source_text: 则正东为卯，正南为午，正西为酉，正北为子。

en.t: Then due east corresponds to mao, due south to wu, due west to you, and due north to zi.

units.source_text: 其余：东南为辰巳，西南为未申，东北为丑寅，西北为戌亥。

en.t: For the remaining directions, southeast corresponds to chen and si, southwest to wei and shen, northeast to chou and yin, and northwest to xu and hai.
